msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?

Of course! For the most convenient access to diving, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—our dive base is at both, and pick-up is direct.

Other nearby options with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up can be arranged from hotels with boat access; depending on the hotel, you may meet the boat at a nearby dock. Accommodation isn’t included in the dive plans, so you’d book directly with the hotel.

If you’re staying on the islands, pick-up and return are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Would you like me to share the diving options for guests staying on the islands once you’ve chosen your dates?

Book the refresher for guests already on the islands: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en
